series_summary: Rentaro Aijo encounters his destined third soulmate, the painfully shy and mute bookworm Shizuka Yoshimoto, in the school library. To bridge the silence that has isolated her from the world, Rentaro immerses himself in her favorite romance novel, passionately reenacting its climax to win her trust, and manually transcribes the entire book into a digital text-to-speech app so her beloved characters can give voice to her deepest thoughts. Confronting his existing girlfriends Hakari and Karane on the school rooftop, Rentaro and Shizuka bravely face their scrutiny, ultimately winning their hearts and uniting all three soulmates in a heartwarming bond of mutual devotion.

title: A Silent Heart Pushed To The Brink — Part 3

segments.voiceover_text: Sitting together in the sunny courtyard, Shizuka nervously guides Rentaro's gaze across printed passages confessing the painful origins of her silence.
Cruel classmates once mocked her quiet voice, leaving her terrified of speaking aloud until romance books became her only dependable sanctuary from rejection.
Rentaro warmly thanks her for trusting him, swearing with fierce sincerity that she never needs to force her spoken voice just to please others.

Suddenly, a careless stumble nearly sends her precious novel tumbling straight toward a water fountain, while Hakari and Karane spot Rentaro's disappearance. Can he hide this encounter before jealousy explodes?
